Name: Train Tracks - Continued
Author: CyanFire
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/aedenthorn/about-me?gameId=1303]aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10927]Train Tracks[/url] mod.


This mod lets you place train tracks as flooring (or on existing flooring) and spawn a mine cart to ride on them.

[youtube]DU4OfwJRWY4[/youtube]

[youtube]OxEYHKSw-EQ[/youtube]


[b][size=4]Laying Tracks[/size][/b]

To toggle laying tracks, press [b]Insert[/b].

To move between track types press [b]Page Up[/b] and [b]Page Down[/b].

To place a track, press [b]Left Mouse[/b].

To remove a track, press [b]Right Mouse[/b].


[b][size=4]Riding the Train[/size][/b]

To spawn a mine cart, hover over a track tile and press [b]Enter[/b].

To get on the cart, move to it and press [b]Right Mouse[/b].

To speed up the cart, hold down [b]Up Arrow[/b].

To slow down the cart, hold down [b]Down Arrow[/b].

To reverse directions, press [b]R[/b].

To turn left at the next junction, hold down [b]Left Arrow[/b].

To turn right at the next junction, hold down [b]Right Arrow[/b].

To get off the cart, press [b]Right Mouse[/b].


[b][size=4]Notes[/size][/b]

All keys except getting into and out of the cart are configurable.

The max speed is 20, you can change this in the config.

All mod sounds are configurable.

You can place a track on existing flooring, but you must remove the track to place new flooring.

To edit the config, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or edit the config.json file created on first run.


[size=4][b]Custom Textures[/b][/size]

You can change the texture of the tracks or mine cart using Content Patcher. The paths are:

[b]"Mods/aedenthorn.TrainTracks/Tracks"[/b] for the tracks

[b]"Mods/aedenthorn.TrainTracks/Train"[/b] for the parts of the train behind the player

[b]"Mods/aedenthorn.TrainTracks/TrainFront"[/b] for the parts of the train in front of the player


[size=4][b]Switches and Speed Tiles[/b][/size]
[s]
[/s]You can program junction tile with switches and add speed change tiles using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28203/]Object Import Map - Continued[/url]


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/CyanFireUK/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/CyanFireUK/StardewValleyMods[/url].
